queries.query_text: ClinicalTrials.gov phase III fecal microbiota transplantation immune checkpoint inhibitor solid tumor
Are there any registered Phase III randomized controlled trials evaluating fecal microbiota transplantation combined with immune checkpoint inhibitors in patients with solid tumors?

still_missing: The supplied material does not explicitly confirm the absolute absence of all ongoing or completed but unpublished Phase III trials in the registries, as the search was designed to include all phases for meta-analysis rather than specifically filtering for Phase III status to confirm absence. While the included list shows a predominance of Phase I/II trials and one Phase 2/3 trial (NCT03686202), it does not definitively rule out other registered Phase III trials that may not have met inclusion criteria (e.g., no results posted). The search strategy date (September 30, 2024) and databases are documented, but a specific negative finding for Phase III trials is implied rather than explicitly stated as a primary outcome.
usable_content: 现有材料未提供关于在 ClinicalTrials.gov 或 WHO ICTRP 注册的、针对实体瘤患者且联合免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）的微生态干预（如 FMT、益生菌或定义明确的菌群组合）的 III 期随机对照试验（RCT）的具体注册信息或编号。相反，多项研究明确指出当前证据主要局限于早期阶段：一项针对结直肠癌微生态调节剂的临床试验综述（截至 2025 年 6 月）仅识别出 29 项试验，全部为 I 期（n=7）、I/II 期（n=7）或 II 期（n=9），未列出任何 III 期试验；另一项文献计量分析（涵盖至 2026 年 3 月的 Web of Science 数据）也确认已发表证据主要来自单臂早期研究，并强调亟需大型 III 期 RCT 来验证疗效，暗示此类试验在已发表文献中尚不存在。此外，MITRIC 试验（NCT05286294）是一项单臂 IIa 期篮式试验，而非 III 期 RCT，其结果显示在 ICI 耐药的晚期实体瘤挽救治疗中，FMT 未观察到客观缓解（ORR 0%），进一步反映了该领域目前缺乏高级别确证性证据的现状。因此，基于所提供的材料，无法确认存在已注册或完成的 III 期 RCT，反而一致表明该领域仍处于早期临床探索阶段。
